/**
 * M0 foes of the Bầy Héo: E09, E11, E18, E19, E01, E25 (02 §2.1 stats, §2.2
 * behaviour; DESIGN.md §9 M0). Numbers are chapter-1 values; the sim scales
 * HP and damage by g(c) (00 §4.1). Seeded by the architect from 02; owner:
 * sim-battle (LANES.md), who verifies and extends them.
 * Grey-box placeholders: one colour per family, silhouette by gait (biped
 * tall capsule, quadruped long low box, flyer floating sphere, swarm tiny box).
 * Sizes are set so the default camera draws them at 05 §2.3's pixel bands
 * (dh-scale.mjs at 1080p): bipeds and flyers 32–44 px, swarms ≥ 26 px.

import type { EnemyDef, EnemyId, Family, PlaceholderDef } from "../types";

/** Family colours for the grey box; never a semantic colour (05 §2.2). */
export const FAMILY_COLORS: Readonly<Record<Family, string>> = {
  moss: "#6f8f4e",
  beast: "#8a6b52",
  bug: "#5b6078",
  spore: "#9c7aa0",
  stone: "#7d7f86",
  wing: "#4f5a6e",
  mist: "#8a86a8",
  tide: "#4f8a86",
};

const box = (family: Family, shape: PlaceholderDef["shape"], sizeM: PlaceholderDef["sizeM"], hoverM = 0): PlaceholderDef => ({
  shape,
  color: FAMILY_COLORS[family],
  sizeM,
  hoverM,
});

const sounds = (id: EnemyId, skill = false) => ({
  attack: "enemy." + id + ".attack",
  hit: "enemy." + id + ".hit",
  death: "enemy." + id + ".death",
  ...(skill ? { skill: "enemy." + id + ".skill" } : {}),
});
